name: Flowsery
description: Flowsery is a privacy-friendly web analytics and session recording tool that attributes revenue to traffic sources and flags UX issues with AI.

events.d: Record a payment or refund and attribute its revenue to the visitor's traffic source.
Record a custom goal completion for a website, optionally tied to a visitor and session.
Get identity, activity, revenue and profile data for one visitor by visitor ID.
Get visitors, sessions, bounce rate, revenue and conversion metrics for a date range.
Get visitors, sessions and revenue grouped by hour, day, week or month.
Get visitors and revenue grouped by a chosen dimension like channel, page, country or UTM.
Get the number of visitors active on a website in the last 5 minutes.
List AI-detected issues from session recordings, or get one issue with full detail.
Delete custom goal events by visitor, goal name or date range.
Delete payment records by transaction ID, visitor or date range.
Runs when Flowsery's AI detects a new issue in session recordings, optionally filtered by severity.

recipes.ae: List a record by Record ID
